text: I think many young people want to work in IT, because the salaries are high and you can often work from home. Jobs in banks and in law are also popular, because they look serious and give good opportunities. Some young people prefer to start their own small business, for example online shops or cafés. In the past, people wanted to be doctors or engineers, but today the situation is more varied.

tips.en: Because explains at once why the job is popular.
tips.kk: Because кәсіптің неге танымал екенін бірден түсіндіреді.
tips.ru: Because сразу объясняет, почему профессия популярна.
tips.example: I think many young people want to work in IT, because the salaries are high

tips.en: Comparing with the past shows change.
tips.example: In the past, people wanted to be doctors or engineers, but today the situation is more varied

questions.followUp: Why do you think they are popular?
questions.question: What jobs are popular among young people in your country?

text: Yes, I think it's very important. People spend about eight hours a day at work, so if they don't enjoy it, they will be unhappy for most of their life. When you like your job, you work better and you are more creative. Of course, the salary is important too, because everybody needs money. But I think a good job is a mix of both: interesting work and a fair salary.

tips.en: Starting with Yes answers the question at once.
tips.kk: Yes-пен бастау сұраққа бірден жауап береді.
tips.ru: Начало с Yes сразу отвечает на вопрос.
tips.example: Yes, I think it's very important

tips.en: End with a thought that balances two factors.
tips.ru: Заканчивайте мыслью о балансе двух факторов.
tips.example: But I think a good job is a mix of both

questions.followUp: Would you take a boring job for a high salary?
questions.question: Is it important to enjoy your job?

text: I think so, because everybody has different abilities, not only men or women. A woman can be a good pilot or an engineer, and a man can be a good teacher or a nurse. In the past, there were many rules about this, but now it's changing. However, some jobs are still very physical, so fewer women choose them. In my opinion, people should choose the job they like, and companies should give everyone equal chances.

tips.en: Two symmetrical examples strengthen the argument.
tips.kk: Екі симметриялық мысал дәлелді күшті етеді.
tips.ru: Два симметричных примера делают аргумент сильным.
tips.example: A woman can be a good pilot or an engineer, and a man can be a good teacher or a nurse

tips.en: In my opinion marks the final position.
tips.kk: In my opinion қорытынды ұстанымды бөліп көрсетеді.
tips.ru: In my opinion ясно выделяет итоговую позицию.
tips.example: In my opinion, people should choose the job they like

questions.followUp: Are there any jobs that are only for men or women?
questions.question: Do you think men and women should do the same jobs?

text: There can be many reasons. Some people want a higher salary or a better position, so they move to another company. Others feel bored after a few years and want something new. Also, sometimes people lose their jobs because the company closes. I think changing jobs can be good, because you learn new skills, but if you do it too often, employers may think you are not reliable.

tips.en: So links the motive to the action.
tips.example: Some people want a higher salary or a better position, so they move to another company

tips.en: May shows a possible risk gently.
tips.example: but if you do it too often, employers may think you are not reliable

questions.question: Why do some people change their jobs many times?
